findings.issue: Rating validation condition is logically always false, so out-of-range ratings are never rejected.
findings.evidence: if (!Number.isInteger(rating) || (rating < 1 && rating > 5)) — rating=99 passes (99<1 is false, so the && is false; isInteger is true), so no 400 is returned and an invalid rating is persisted. Should be `rating < 1 || rating > 5`.

findings.issue: getReviewsSorted interpolates the raw `sort` query parameter directly into ORDER BY with no allowlist, enabling SQL injection.
findings.evidence: `ORDER BY ${sort}` with sort = (req.query.sort as string) || 'r.created_at DESC' in src/routes/api.ts — unlike getBooksPage's BOOK_SORT_COLUMNS allowlist, arbitrary SQL fragments can be injected via GET /books/:id/reviews?sort=...

findings.issue: Pagination offset uses page*pageSize instead of (page-1)*pageSize, so page=1 skips the first pageSize rows.
findings.evidence: [pageSize, page * pageSize] — with page=1, pageSize=10, OFFSET is 10, so the first 10 books never appear on 'page 1' despite the comment stating 'page starts at 1'.

findings.issue: User-controlled display_name is interpolated into raw HTML without escaping, enabling stored XSS.
findings.evidence: `${top.display_name} rated it ${top.rating}/5` sent via res.send() with no escaping; display_name is user-supplied at account creation and rendered unescaped, unlike EJS views which auto-escape by default.
